title: Ready Cohorts: Bounding GPU Opportunity and Avoiding Host Round Trips in LLM-Agent Control
abstract: arXiv:2608.12123v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-agent services repeatedly execute small deterministic transitions between model and tool calls: route an outcome, update state, and emit the next effect. We ask when this control path exposes enough concurrent work for GPU execution, and what changes when a GPU-computed route decision remains on device. We formalize the ready-cohort boundary using fixed-partition share F, exact offline share P*, local upper bound U, and online achieved share A. Under zero service time, unlimited capacity, and equal relative launch deadlines, a specialized dynamic program computes P* exactly. In a stationary Poisson replay of one pinned 851-session public trace panel, the primary condition at 100,000 target active sessions, K=256, and a 50 ms launch deadline gives F=30.19%, P*=43.00%, and U=45.85%. Exact packing recovers 81.83% of the opportunity lost at fixed window boundaries. The outcome-derived route key is a conditioning proxy, not proof of exe

translated_title: 就绪队列：在LLM智能体控制中界定GPU机会并避免主机往返
translated_abstract: LLM智能体服务在模型调用和工具调用之间反复执行小的确定性转换：路由结果、更新状态、发出下一个效果。我们探究这一控制路径何时能暴露足够的并发工作以供GPU执行，以及当GPU计算的路由决策保留在设备上时会发生什么变化。我们使用固定分区份额F、精确离线份额P*、局部上界U和在线实现份额A来形式化就绪队列边界。在零服务时间、无限容量和相等的相对启动截止时间下，一个专门的动态规划可精确计算P*。在对一个固定的851会话公共轨迹面板的静态泊松重放中，在100,000个目标活动会话、K=256和50毫秒启动截止时间的主要条件下，F=30.19%，P*=43.00%，U=45.85%。精确打包恢复了在固定窗口边界丢失机会的81.83%。结果派生的路由键是一个条件代理，而非执行证明。
tldr: 本文提出就绪队列概念，通过动态规划精确计算GPU并发机会的边界，并在实际轨迹中恢复大部分丢失的机会，同时指出路由键仅作为条件代理。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the ready-cohort concept, precisely bounding GPU concurrency opportunities via dynamic programming, recovering most lost opportunities in real traces, while noting that route keys serve only as conditioning proxies.
